scope: Selective original-language checking of GA110 V–VIII. This document contains precise limited contextual comparisons and unresolved editorial issues, not full German collation.

issues.resolution_needed: Collate critical German GA110 edition, SOL and at least one older English translation; retain ambiguity in all graph summaries.
